context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 109 verified new Risk Calculator feature. Backend endpoints: POST /api/risk-calc/calculate (single TP), POST /api/risk-calc/multi-tp (multiple TPs). Position sizing methods: risk_pct (% of account), fixed_dollar (fixed $ risk), kelly (Kelly criterion capped at 25%). Frontend: Risk Calculator accessible via user menu dropdown (data-testid='nav-risk-calc-btn'). Modal has: symbol input (risk-calc-symbol), buy/sell toggle (risk-calc-side-buy/sell), entry/SL/TP fields (risk-calc-entry/sl/tp), sizing method buttons (risk-calc-method-risk_pct/fixed_dollar/kelly), risk % presets (1%/2%/3%/5%), Calculate button (risk-calc-submit), result panel (risk-calc-result) with R:R gauge (rr-gauge). Apply to Smart Order button closes calculator and opens Smart Orders panel.
